picks.title: 223- What Stories are Actually True? I Porter Rockwell I Church History Matters
picks.summary: Porter was more than a legendary frontiersman and lawman. He was a close friend of Joseph Smith, a protector of the Prophet, and a man whose life was deeply shaped by the events surrounding Joseph’s death. In June 1844, Porter helped Joseph and Hyrum cross the Mississippi River as they sought to avoid arrest. When Joseph decided to return to Nauvoo and face the authorities, Porter accompanied him part of the way toward Carthage. Joseph ultimately asked him to return to Nauvoo, concerned for his safety. It was the last time Porter saw Joseph alive.Porter's battle cry was, "Wheat! Wheat! Wheat!"
picks.reason: Story of Porter Rockwell's loyalty to Joseph Smith, reflecting restoration-era faith.

picks.title: The Mormon Founding of Salt Lake City
picks.summary:
What drew the Latter Day Saints to Utah? Was anyone living there before the arrival of Brigham Young? And how did the city develop?


Max Perry Mueller joins Don today to discuss Salt Lake City. Max is an associate professor of Religious Studies at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln. He writes more about this topic in 'Wakara’s America: The Life and Legacy of a Native Founder of the American West'.

picks.title: Isaiah 29: A Marvelous Work and a Wonder | Come Follow Me for Kids
picks.summary: What is the “marvellous work and a wonder” Isaiah prophesied about?In today’s Seek HIM First episode, kids will explore Isaiah 29 and learn about the Restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ and the coming forth of the Book of Mormon. Isaiah saw something amazing that would happen hundreds of years in the future, and today, we get to be part of that marvelous story!We’ll play a fun “Marvelous or Not Marvelous?” game, test our knowledge with trivia, and discover how we can look for the marvelous things Heavenly Father is doing in our lives.Scripture: Isaiah 29:14Come, Follow Me: Isaiah 13–14;
